topic.title: Release Notes – Z1 Encryption Server v5.2
topic.shortdesc: This document summarizes the key changes, improvements, and fixes in version 5.2 of the Z1 Encryption Server.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Version 5.2 introduces several performance enhancements and new administrative features that improve the efficiency, reliability, and security of encrypted communications.

ul.li: Enhanced Key Management: Added support for ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography) keys up to 521 bits.
Improved Web Interface: Redesigned dashboard with faster response time and new search filters.
API Tokens: Introduced secure API tokens for automation and integration with third-party systems.
Optimized startup process to reduce initialization time by 25%.
Refined log file management for easier debugging and traceability.
Updated LDAP integration module for improved connection stability.
Resolved an issue where scheduled backups occasionally failed under high load.
Fixed incorrect display of license expiration date in the admin panel.
Addressed a UI alignment issue on smaller screens.

section.title: Known Issues
section.p: In some environments, the initial configuration wizard may require a manual browser refresh. A patch will be provided in version 5.2.1.

section.title: Upgrade Notes
section.p: Before upgrading from version 5.1, export your existing key configurations and verify database backups. Run the upgrade installer as administrator and confirm all services restart successfully.
